Mechanical and control functions

Revision 0 Machine Rotary tablet press (double-sided),
Date of issue 16-Feb-2026 customer tag TP-202
A. Machine data (as built)
Serial number TRXD-24-0932
Model TRX-D 41
Number of punch stations 41 stations
B. Release of the test procedure
Step Name Company Signature Date
Issued Luca Bertoni Rotaforma Macchine S.r.l. Signed electronically 16-Feb-2026
Reviewed (customer) Bayu Pratama PT Arunika Farma Lestari Signed electronically 26-Feb-2026
Released for test (customer) Dewi Anggraini PT Arunika Farma Lestari Signed electronically 26-Feb-2026
C. Test records
Test case TC-01
Procedure Run the empty turret from minimum to maximum speed; record the lowest and highest stable speed.
Required 10–80 rpm
Measured 10–80 rpm
Verdict PASS
Test case TC-02
Procedure Run placebo at maximum turret speed for 10 minutes on both sides; count the tablets and convert to tablets per hour.
Required ≥ 300,000 tablets/h
Measured 312,000 tablets/h
Verdict PASS
Test case TC-03
Procedure Apply main compression with the test tooling; record the highest force reached.
Required ≥ 80 kN
Measured 76 kN
Verdict FAIL
Test case TC-04
Procedure Set pre-compression to maximum; record the force shown by the force channel.
Required ≥ 20 kN
Measured 22 kN
Verdict PASS
Test case TC-05
Procedure Check the material certificates of the product-contact parts against the parts list.
Required SS 316L
Measured SS 316L
Verdict PASS

Test case TC-06
Procedure Measure surface roughness Ra on the die table and feeder.
Required ≤ 0.8 µm

Test case TC-07
Procedure Load the product recipe on the HMI, simulate a weight drift and confirm that the force-based weight control corrects it.
Required Present and functional
Measured Present and functional
Verdict PASS
Test case TC-08
Procedure Press each emergency stop button while the turret is running; the machine must stop.
Required Present and functional
Measured Present and functional
Verdict PASS
